CustomField.label: Period (days)
CustomField.description: Interval in calendar days between consecutive occurrences (7 = weekly, 14 = every two weeks). Mutually exclusive with AXF_SDF_NUM_PeriodMonths__c: exactly one of the two is set. The nominal due date is FirstDueDate + (sequence - FirstSequence) x PeriodDays, with no anchor day (AXF-155).
